feat: age-based coloring for kubectl get via duration thresholds (#360)

* feat: color object age by configurable duration thresholds

Generalize the single fresh/not-fresh age coloring into an ordered list of
thresholds (KUBECOLOR_OBJ_FRESH) paired by position with a color list
(theme.data.durationFresh). Ages older than every threshold, or beyond the
color list, fall back to theme.data.duration.

Backward compatible: a single duration/color still works as a one-element
list, and the default (empty thresholds) leaves output unchanged.

the /-separated durations must be ordered from shortest to longest.
